description:
Long-Range Power with Moped-Style Comfort

The Kornorge T73 Electric Bike combines strong motor performance, long-range battery capability, and a comfortable moped-style riding platform. Its 1000W rated motor delivers up to 1500W peak output and 80 N·m of torque, providing responsive acceleration and confident assistance for everyday commuting, hills, and recreational riding.

A removable 48V 15.6Ah battery supports up to 70 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal conditions, while full suspension, hydraulic disc brakes, 20 × 4.0 inch anti-puncture fat tires, and a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain help deliver a stable and controlled riding experience across city streets and light mixed terrain.

Why Choose the Kornorge T73 Electric Bike?

1500W Peak Motor
The 1000W rated motor delivers up to 1500W peak output and 80 N·m of torque for responsive acceleration, confident climbing, and strong everyday performance.

48V 15.6Ah Removable Battery
The removable lithium-ion battery supports up to 70 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal riding conditions and can be conveniently charged on or off the bike.

Up to 28 mph Top Speed
A maximum assisted speed of up to 28 mph provides stronger performance for commuting and recreational riding, where local regulations permit.

Full-Suspension Comfort
Front and rear suspension help absorb bumps and road vibration, improving comfort and stability across pavement, uneven streets, gravel paths, and other mixed surfaces.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes
Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes provide responsive and consistent stopping power for city traffic, higher-speed riding, and changing road conditions.

20 × 4.0 Inch Anti-Puncture Fat Tires
Wide fat tires provide a larger contact patch for improved traction, balance, and stability while helping the T73 feel planted across a variety of everyday surfaces.

Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 7-speed drivetrain provides additional flexibility when pedaling across different speeds, gradients, and riding conditions.

Smart LCD Display
The detachable digital LCD display keeps important riding information visible, including speed, battery status, distance, and assistance level.

Extended Comfort Saddle
The long 23.62-inch saddle provides generous seating space for a relaxed moped-style riding position during commuting, cruising, and longer everyday journeys.

Who Is the Kornorge T73 Electric Bike For?

Daily Commuters
The combination of strong motor assistance, long-range battery capacity, hydraulic braking, and full suspension makes the T73 well suited for regular urban and suburban travel.

Riders Seeking More Range
With up to 70 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal conditions, the T73 is designed for riders who want greater flexibility between charges.

Comfort-Focused Riders
Full suspension, wide fat tires, and an extended moped-style saddle help provide a stable and comfortable riding experience over longer journeys.

Mixed-Surface Riders
The 20 × 4.0 inch fat tires and suspension system provide added confidence on pavement, gravel paths, park trails, and other light mixed-terrain surfaces.

Riders Who Prefer a Moped-Style Platform
The long saddle, upright riding position, and robust frame give the T73 a motorcycle-inspired feel while retaining pedal-assist functionality.

Maximum Range
Up to 70 Miles in Pedal-Assist Mode

Maximum Speed
Up to 28 mph, Where Local Regulations Permit

Tire Size
20 × 4.0 Inch Anti-Puncture Fat Tires

Net Weight
99.42 lb / 45.1 kg, Including Battery

Lighting
Front LED Headlight and Integrated Rear Brake Light

Maximum speed, range, climbing ability, and other performance figures are based on manufacturer specifications and testing. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, assistance level, terrain, weather, temperature, tire pressure, battery condition, and riding conditions. Always follow applicable local e-bike laws and regulations.
